title: Tall whites playing 'airplanes' on the Indian Springs runways

tellings.quote: I I used to watch them play at the runways at Indian Springs Air Base on summer nights

plain: On summer nights in the mid-1960s, tall, pale beings are said to have played on the runways of Indian Springs Air Base, a small base in the Nevada desert. Charles Hall, a former Air Force man who says he spent three years among the beings he calls the Tall Whites, says he watched them himself. "I used to watch them play at the runways," he says, as part of his account of living alongside them.
